description.value: The study investigated neural correlates of processing task-irrelevant disorder-related scenes in social anxiety disorder as a function of symptom severity using functional MRI.

spans.text: The present study investigated the neural correlates of processing task-irrelevant, highly ecologically valid, disorder-related stimuli as a function of symptom severity in SAD.
